adjudication.rationale: Looking at the test in spec/jobs/poll_feed_spec.rb lines 17-21, the test 'requires feed_polling_url' only stubs feed_polling_url to nil but doesn't stub feed_polling_enabled? to true. Looking at the execute method in app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb lines 13-17, the condition is `SiteSetting.feed_polling_enabled? && SiteSetting.feed_polling_url.present? && SiteSetting.embed_by_username.present?`. Since feed_polling_enabled? defaults to false (per config/site_settings.yml line 355), the test short-circuits on the first condition and never actually tests the feed_polling_url guard. This is a real test defect - the test would pass even if the URL check was removed.
